module: Processes the jbeam "mirrors" section. For each entry with a mesh field, registers the mirror in the engine (addMirror with mesh, idRef, id1, id2) and gets the resulting id in v.id, then configures the mirror object: offset (refBaseTranslation or offset), normal (deduced from baseRotationGlobal in degrees or from normal) and offsetNormal (deprecated fields). Entries without mesh are considered old data.
notes: baseRotationGlobal is in degrees {x, y, z}; the normal is obtained by rotating the vector (0,1,0).
The fields offsetRotationGlobal and offsetNormal are deprecated: they trigger a migration error message in the log but are still applied. A directly provided normal also logs a migration message.
If addMirror returns a negative id, the entry is ignored.

process.desc: Creates and configures the mirrors declared in vehicle.mirrors.
